verdict.rationale: Granola documents some user-configurable background automations: an official Zapier integration to "automate what happens after a meeting" and HubSpot auto-sync that saves notes added to folders to CRM records. It also runs fixed built-in background jobs such as overnight pre-meeting briefs and automatic follow-up email drafts. However, there is no native automation builder, and Chat workflows require a review step, so they are not autonomous. Missing for 10: a first-party general-purpose automation/trigger builder, documentation of configurable autonomous actions beyond the HubSpot and Zapier integrations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
